instruction: You are given a pipe template `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_base/`. Complete a parallel-computing task from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_parallel/`: - Build a 3D circular-pipe geometry and configure laminar or turbulent parameters - Set domain decomposition strategy (>= 4 subdomains) 2. Execute the full workflow: mesh decomposition, parallel solve, and result reconstruction. 3. Extract the outlet mass flow rate. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Outlet mass flow rate `mass_flow` - Format: `mass_flow` 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
